formal_role: Defines the ordered values being analyzed
systems_modeling_role: Clarifies whether values represent states estimates terms errors or iterations
review_warning: A convergence claim is not auditable unless the sequence is defined

formal_role: Defines finite cumulative totals before the infinite limit
systems_modeling_role: Keeps computed finite sums separate from infinite-series claims
review_warning: A partial sum should not be reported as an infinite total without convergence evidence

systems_modeling_role: Documents whether stopping was based on term count tolerance error bound or runtime
review_warning: A stopped computation is not necessarily a converged computation

systems_modeling_role: Supports responsible interpretation of finite approximations
review_warning: Small latest term does not always imply small remainder

formal_role: Checks whether the magnitudes of terms form a convergent series
systems_modeling_role: Distinguishes bounded total magnitude from net cancellation
review_warning: Conditional convergence can hide large gross activity
